name: example-aurora-launch-glass
title: Aurora Launch
description: Premium invite-only waitlist hero: a slow-drifting indigo-to-rose-gold aurora mesh breathes behind a frosted-glass signup card, a magnetic CTA settles under exponential damping toward a self-driven idle target, and a digit-flip countdown ticks live — every element self-animated so the card is never static.
credits: Magnetic CTA chase damping adapted (formula only) from darkroomengineering/lenis (MIT); reimplemented from scratch in 2D canvas.

useCase.query: Make a premium invite-only waitlist page — a slow-drifting aurora gradient mesh behind a frosted-glass signup card, a magnetic call-to-action, and a live countdown — that stays in constant, calm, self-driven motion with no user interaction.
